Author: Birch
Name: Saucer Nights
Description: Play blackjack and no-limit Texas Hold'em with friends over a cross-world linkshell. One player hosts and deals; everyone else joins from the lobby. Animated tables, encrypted hole cards, provably fair shuffles, practice tables against bots and a chip ledger for the host. Chips are play money: the plugin never trades gil.
Punchline: Blackjack and hold'em over your linkshell.
